summary.text: Wendy Schuler, listed on Ballotpedia as Wendy Davis Schuler, is a Republican member of the Wyoming State Senate for District 15 who took office in January 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She chairs the Senate Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Wendy Davis Schuler assumed office on January 7, 2019, succeeding Paul Barnard.

For 2025-2026 she chaired the Senate Education Committee and the Joint Education Committee and was assigned to the Senate Travel, Recreation, Wildlife and Cultural Resources Committee and the Select Committee on School Finance Recalibration.
She defeated Tina Johnson, Jen Hegeman and Chris Katzl in the August 18, 2026 Republican primary, receiving 61.8% of the vote, and no Democrat appeared on the primary ballot.
